symbol.title: Clear skies
symbol.desc: A sun with eight rays, used for clear daytime weather and for sunlit outdoor places.

symbol.title: Night
symbol.desc: A crescent moon marking night hours and the night-time lighting preset.

symbol.title: Overcast
symbol.desc: A soft cumulus outline for cloudy weather.

symbol.title: Monsoon rain
symbol.desc: A cloud with three falling drops, for rain and the monsoon weather state.

symbol.title: Breeze
symbol.desc: Three drifting air lines, used for wind and ventilation cues.

symbol.title: City clock
symbol.desc: A clock face reading ten past, for the in-world time and time-scale controls.

symbol.title: Day
symbol.desc: A calendar page marking the simulated day counter.

symbol.title: Location
symbol.desc: A map pin, used for the current district and for any single place on the map.

symbol.title: City map
symbol.desc: A compass rose inside a ring, opening the full city map.

symbol.title: Neighbourhood map
symbol.desc: A folded paper map for the full-city view.

symbol.title: Route
symbol.desc: A path winding between two nodes, for a set destination.

symbol.title: Destination
symbol.desc: A pennant on a pole, marking a destination or a completed goal.

symbol.title: Continue
symbol.desc: A right-pointing arrow for forward actions and links.

symbol.title: Back
symbol.desc: A left-pointing arrow for returning to the previous view.

symbol.title: Health
symbol.desc: A heart, showing the resident's health.

symbol.title: Energy
symbol.desc: A lightning bolt for stamina and energy.

symbol.title: Fullness
symbol.desc: A fork and knife, for hunger, food items and eateries.

symbol.title: Your bag
symbol.desc: A shopping bag with handles, for the inventory.

symbol.title: Resident
symbol.desc: A single person, used for an individual resident.

symbol.title: Neighbours
symbol.desc: Two overlapping figures, for crowds and community.

symbol.title: Talk
symbol.desc: A speech bubble, for conversation with residents.

symbol.title: Journal
symbol.desc: An open book, for the journal and the day's goals.

symbol.title: Goal complete
symbol.desc: A tick inside a circle, marking a finished goal.

symbol.title: Favourite
symbol.desc: A five-point star for favourites and highlights.

symbol.title: Auto-rickshaw
symbol.desc: A three-wheeler in profile, the signature vehicle of the city.

symbol.title: Car
symbol.desc: A small hatchback in profile, for cars and driving.

symbol.title: City bus
symbol.desc: A bus front with windows and lamps, for public transport.

symbol.title: Two-wheeler
symbol.desc: A bicycle silhouette, for cycles and scooters.

symbol.title: Fuel
symbol.desc: A petrol pump beside a tank, for fuel level and filling stations.

symbol.title: Repairs
symbol.desc: A spanner, for mechanics, repairs and vehicle condition.

symbol.title: Speed
symbol.desc: A speedometer needle, for speed and performance readouts.

symbol.title: Home
symbol.desc: A house with a door, for homes and residential places.

symbol.title: Shop
symbol.desc: An awning over a storefront, for shops and markets.

symbol.title: Chai
symbol.desc: A steaming cup, for tea stalls and a moment's rest.

symbol.title: Rupees
symbol.desc: The rupee sign, for cash, prices and the wallet.

symbol.title: Hospital
symbol.desc: A cross inside a building, for medical services.

symbol.title: Police
symbol.desc: A shield with a tick, for the police and civic safety.

symbol.title: School
symbol.desc: A graduation cap, for schools and the campus district.

symbol.title: Place of worship
symbol.desc: A shikhara over a plinth, for temples and other places of worship.

symbol.title: Park
symbol.desc: A round-canopied tree, for gardens and green space.

symbol.title: Bank
symbol.desc: A columned facade, for banking, savings and deposits.

symbol.title: Settings
symbol.desc: A cog, for graphics, sound, weather and time settings.

symbol.title: Pause
symbol.desc: Two upright bars, pausing the city.

symbol.title: Resume
symbol.desc: A forward triangle, resuming play.

symbol.title: Close
symbol.desc: A cross, dismissing a panel or dialogue.

symbol.title: Done
symbol.desc: A tick, confirming an action.

symbol.title: Save
symbol.desc: A floppy disk, writing the journey to this device.

symbol.title: Load
symbol.desc: A restore arrow, bringing back a saved journey.

symbol.title: City sounds on
symbol.desc: A speaker with sound waves, for the ambient soundscape.

symbol.title: City sounds off
symbol.desc: A muted speaker, with the soundscape switched off.

symbol.title: Controls
symbol.desc: A keyboard, opening the controls and help panel.

symbol.title: Help
symbol.desc: A question mark in a circle, for guidance and hints.

symbol.title: Information
symbol.desc: An information mark, for neutral explanatory notes.

symbol.title: Attention
symbol.desc: A warning triangle, for incidents and urgent notices.

symbol.title: Photo mode
symbol.desc: A camera body with a lens, for capture and photo mode.

symbol.title: View
symbol.desc: An eye, for visibility, first-person view and preview toggles.

symbol.title: Detail level
symbol.desc: Stacked planes, for graphics quality and level of detail.

symbol.title: Highlight
symbol.desc: A four-point sparkle, for new, generated or highlighted content.
